1971年，11月。

京市军区大院，厉家。

“林见微，我说过，我和书瑶姑姑之间清清白白，你非要往脏处想是不是？！”

“她不过回京参加文艺汇演，在家呆不了几天，你就那么歹毒，非要置她于死地？！”

“给我好好跪在这儿反省！什么时候承认错了，什么时候再起来！”

林见微跪在院内雪地里，冻得嘴唇发紫，长长的睫毛上结了一层霜。

男人的骂声在耳边嗡嗡响，可她脑子里却昏昏沉沉的，像蒙了一层雾。

就在刚刚，她做了一个很长的梦……

梦里，她发现自己活在一本年代文小说里。

而她存在的意义，就是不停地给男女主找麻烦、当绊脚石。

说难听点。

她就是作者笔下那个专门用来衬托男女主情比金坚的工具人。

一个迟早要被剧情抛弃的、彻头彻尾的炮灰。

大院里谁不知道。

厉首长的长孙厉延洲，和从小寄住在厉家的养女乔书瑶，两人青梅竹马，曾有过一段轰轰烈烈的爱情。

后来为了厉家声誉，厉首长硬是把两人拆散，把乔书瑶送去了羊城军区的文工团。

而林见微，就是在这时候出现的。

林见微出身在高知家庭，父亲是早年公派苏联的顶尖物理学家，出事前在研究所工作。

母亲是京北大学文学系教授，在文坛与学术界都颇有声望。

上头还有三个哥哥，大哥从军，二哥从政，三哥嘛……不提也罢。

按理说，在这样的家庭长大，林见微本该通情达理、明辨是非。

可不知为何，自从遇见厉延洲后，她就像着了魔似的，一门心思扑在他身上。

和厉延州第一次见面，是在一个联谊舞会上。

当时一个四十多岁、油腻猥琐的老男人故意为难林见微。

是厉延洲出面帮她解了围，还邀请她跳了一支舞。

自此之后，林见微就跟那鬼上身一样，为他痴为他狂，为他不顾一切。

天天往军区大院跑，挖空心思讨好厉老爷子。

厉老爷子正愁厉延洲和乔书瑶的事纠缠不清。

见林见微家世不错、便顺水推舟，促成了这门婚事。

1971, November.

Beijing Military Region compound, Li family.

"Lin Jianwei, I told you that the relationship between Aunt Shuyao and me is pure and innocent. You have to think about the dirty things, don't you?!"

"She just went back to Beijing to participate in a cultural performance. She can't stay at home for a few days. How can you be so vicious and insist on putting her to death?!"

"Kneel down here and reflect! When will you admit you were wrong? When will you get up again!"

Lin Jianwei knelt in the snow in the courtyard, his lips turned purple from the cold, and his long eyelashes were covered with a layer of frost.

The man's curses buzzed in her ears, but her mind felt groggy, as if there was a layer of fog.

Just now, she had a long dream...

In her dream, she found herself living in a period novel.

And the meaning of her existence is to constantly cause trouble and serve as a stumbling block for the male and female protagonists.

To put it harshly.

She is the tool person in the author's works who is specially used to set off the love between the male and female protagonists.

A complete cannon fodder who will be abandoned by the plot sooner or later.

No one in the compound knows.

Chief Li's eldest grandson, Li Yanzhou, and his adopted daughter Qiao Shuyao, who had lived in the Li family since childhood, were childhood sweethearts and had a vigorous love affair.

Later, for the sake of the Li family's reputation, Chief Li separated the two and sent Qiao Shuyao to the cultural troupe of the Yangcheng Military Region.

Lin Jianwei appeared at this time.

Lin Jianwei was born in a Kochi family. His father was a top physicist in the Soviet Union who was sent by the government in the early years. He worked in a research institute before the accident.

My mother is a professor in the Literature Department of Peking University and is quite prestigious in both literary and academic circles.

There are three brothers above. The eldest brother is in the army, the second brother is in politics, and the third brother...don't mention it.

Logically speaking, growing up in such a family, Lin Jianwei should have been reasonable and able to distinguish right from wrong.

But for some reason, since she met Li Yanzhou, she seemed to be possessed by him and devoted herself to him.

The first time I met Li Yanzhou was at a social dance.

At that time, a greasy and wretched old man in his forties deliberately made things difficult for Lin Jianwei.

It was Li Yanzhou who came forward to help her out and even invited her to dance.

From then on, Lin Jianwei was just like the ghost, crazy about him and desperate for him.

He ran to the military compound every day, trying his best to please Mr. Li.

Mr. Li was worried about the entanglement between Li Yanzhou and Qiao Shuyao.

Jian Lin Jian Wei's family background was good, so he pushed the situation and facilitated the marriage.
